rationale_one_line: last30days reads the live conversation across every feed, so a wire-service DISPATCH framed in WIRED's broadsheet identity (paper-white grid, mono kickers, single ink-blue accent) makes the tribute feel like a field report filed from the agent lane.
writing_tone_notes: Cool, reportorial, dateline register. Bold declarative opens, contrast over adjectives, contractions where natural. No superlatives. Let the method and the terminal do the proving, not adjectives.
do_rules: Keep the link-blue (#057dbc) accent scarce: one accent line per beat at most, the way WIRED reserves blue for a single interactive cue.
Lead the body with the terminal hero (the command, then the ranked output) so a non-text scene carries the explainer.
Use mono uppercase only where it reads as a kicker or timestamp, serif/sans elsewhere, never mix roles.
dont_rules: No second chromatic accent and no gradients, glow scrims, or rounded cards (WIRED is flat by religion).
No version numbers anywhere in copy.
No phrase repeated verbatim across the tweet, the Why-this-one, and the scene copy.
